subject: english
question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.**

options.text: I don't know weather to eat it or rubb it on.
Goodbye untill later now, foks. Have a good night.
Had I known what was coming, I could have prepared myself better.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Had I known what was coming, I could have prepared myself better."**
